answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond before it can earn, and bind that bond to one verified work history that cannot be split across identities. Like a lantern hung from a single timber post, each identity carries exactly one light: creating a plume of fake accounts would demand a separate bond and a separate history for each one. If an identity is caught double-signing or copying work, its bond is slashed, so a Sybil attack costs real capital per fake instead of costing nothing.
